Title: UQuestGraphBase
Overview:
A QuestGraph is used to encapsulate a single quest. They are built using QuestBlocks and define the logic by which a quest traverses from block to block both linearly and with branching. NOTE: QuestGraphs automatically save all data needed for the base class to function. If your QuestGraph requires saving additional information there are two options:
  • Store the data on the SharedQuestDataObject and handle saving within that class.
  • Follow the save system guide for saving in derived classes that already implement save and load functionality (QuestGraphs are their own SaveAgent).
